summary: A single show/hide panel with a labelled trigger, two icon styles and an optional disabled state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Starting state when you are not controlling it. Pair `open` with `onOpenChange` instead if you are.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new state. Required for a controlled collapsible.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Locks the panel open, replaces the icon with a lock & blocks toggling entirely - a disabled collapsible always shows its content, it does not hide it.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius on the trigger. `square` (no radius) is the plain default here - no rounded variant exists, since none was ever shown for this component.

props.name: icon
props.description: `chevron` rotates one glyph 90°. `plus-minus` swaps between two glyphs with the same rotation flourish.

props.name: iconPosition
props.description: Which end of the trigger the icon sits at.

props.name: animate
props.description: The icon's rotation & the panel's height/opacity animation. Turn it off for an instant expand/collapse, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: className
props.description: Appended to the root's classes, for anything the component leaves unset - a margin, `fs-0` in a flex row. It will not reliably override what the component already sets: which of two utilities wins is decided by the stylesheet's rule order, not by the order you write them.
